settings.subtitle: Everything you need to know before April. Can't find it here? Email hello@horizonsummit.example.

items.question: When and where is Horizon Summit 2027?
items.answer: April 13–15, 2027 at Mueller Commons, 4550 Hangar Lane, Austin, Texas. Doors open at 7:30am each day.

items.question: Who is it for?
items.answer: Engineers, designers, product people and engineering leaders. Talks assume you build or run software for a living.

items.question: Will sessions be recorded?
items.answer: Yes. Recordings of every Main Stage and Hall session are posted to the Attendee Hub within 48 hours. Workshops are not recorded.

items.question: How do I get into the Attendee Hub?
items.answer: Sign in with the account linked to your badge. The Hub has the Wi-Fi details, workshop setup notes, the venue map and recordings.

items.question: How do workshop seats work?
items.answer: Workshops have 60 seats each. Seat allocation opens in the Attendee Hub on January 15, 2027.

items.question: Is there a code of conduct?
items.answer: Yes, and we enforce it. Our safety team is on site and reachable by phone throughout the event.

items.question: Is the venue accessible?
items.answer: The venue is step-free throughout, with live captioning on every stage, reserved seating and quiet rooms on both floors.

items.question: Is there a hotel discount?
items.answer: Yes. See the venue and travel page for our two partner hotels. Book by March 12, 2027.
